beat: Rockstar Social Club native achievement list
game: Grand Theft Auto III - The Definitive Edition

totalClaimed.gta.wiki breakdown: 28 console achievements + 1 platinum-equivalent (King of Liberty City) + 15 Social Club-only = 44
totalClaimed.gtabase breakdown: 28 Xbox/PS + 1 Platinum + 15 Social Club = 44 (page header phrases it '43 Achievements + 1 Platinum')

list.name: King of Liberty City
list.notes: PS list wording is 'Unlock all trophies.' gta.wiki: on Social Club requires the other 43 in one playthrough. Xbox has no equivalent (gtabase: PSN only).

list.name: Without a Scratch
list.description: Deliver Mike Lips' car without a scratch on the first attempt.

list.name: Disposing of the Evidence
list.description: Crush a car at the junkyard.

list.name: Mob Boss
list.description: Keep the two mafia members alive during Triads and Tribulations.

list.name: Planned Ahead
list.description: Take out Chunky Lee Chong with a car rigged with a bomb.

list.name: Got This Figured Out
list.description: Use a Coach to pick up all 8 prostitutes in the mission The Fuzz Ball.

list.name: By a Mile
list.description: Complete the Turismo race in under 180 seconds.

list.name: Wreckless Driving
list.notes: RNG/difficult; some reports of not popping.

list.name: Come Out to Play-y-y-y
list.description: Kill 25 gang members with melee weapons/fists.

list.name: Liberty City Minute
list.description: Survive with less than 10 hp for 1 minute.

list.name: Full Artillery
list.description: Use every weapon in the game at least once.

list.name: A Marked Man
list.notes: Mission; ordering rule: finish Joey/Luigi missions first for 100%.

list.name: Offshore Delivery
list.description: Complete A Drop in the Ocean.

list.name: A Gift from the King
list.notes: Pay phone mission; bug: as last 100% item it may block 'Is That All You've Got?'.

list.name: Man Toyz
list.description: Complete every RC Toyz side mission.
list.notes: gtabase wording paraphrased 'every RC Toyz mission'.

list.name: Splish Splash
list.description: Extinguish 15 fires during a single Firefighter side mission.
list.notes: Counter within one run (gtabase paraphrase says 'Fire Truck mission').

list.name: Playing Doctor
list.description: Complete level 12 of the Paramedic side mission.

list.name: Going Rogue
list.description: Kill 15 criminals during one Vigilante side mission.

list.name: Right-hand Man
list.notes: Criminal rating shown on Stats screen.

list.name: Is That All You've Got?
list.notes: Completion % on Stats screen. Known bug with Kingdom Come last.

list.name: Got Any Stories, Old Man?
list.notes: New in DE. Mission (Salvatore's story mission).

list.name: Talks a Lot
list.notes: New in DE. 17 pay phone missions per scout_c.

list.name: Blood in the Streets
list.notes: Carried from 2015 PS4. Rampage counter in DE Stats unconfirmed.

list.name: Cheaters Do Prosper!
list.notes: Renamed from PS4 'If You Ain't Cheatin', You Ain't Tryin''. Cheats disable achievements per PS reports; this is a kill-count grind.

list.name: Play Fetch
list.description: Complete the Portland Docks and Shoreside Vale import/export car lists.
list.notes: Carried from PS4. A French guide (millenium.org) gives the 'Play Fetch' name a 20-fires description (clearly Relief Pitcher's); treated as error.

list.name: Pest Control
list.description: Deliver all emergency vehicles to the crane at the Portland Docks.
list.notes: Carried from PS4. One guide mentions seven vehicles (unverified). Not part of 100% lists in scout_c (crane list is Portland Crane list).

list.name: Relief Pitcher
list.description: Extinguish 20 fires during a single Firefighter mission.

list.name: Like a Boss
list.description: Earn a criminal rating of 5,000 or higher.

list.name: Fare Game
list.description: Pick up Curly Bob in a Taxi during Cutting the Grass.
list.notes: New in DE. Likely missable (inside a story mission).

conflicts: Count: 44 total on both sources (28 + King of Liberty City + 15 SC-only). gtabase header phrases it as '43 Achievements + 1 Platinum' and gta.wiki prose says '28 gameplay achievements' - consistent with 44 once the arithmetic is done, but wording differs.

Scope split: gta.wiki prose says '28 Social Club achievements overlap with gameplay achievements', and its own new/carried tallies (19 carried, 9 new, 8+7 SC-only) are internally inconsistent (e.g. By a Mile labelled new yet on PS4 list). Do not trust the new/carried labels; names and descriptions of all 44 are consistent between the two sources.

Gamerscore: scout_native says Xbox values sum to 1000 across 28; a fetch summary of gtabase entries 2-29 summed 1025 (that range includes 'Is That All You've Got?' 100, i.e. 28 entries; scout_native's 28 xbox sum = 1000). Likely arithmetic/extraction noise; irrelevant to Pantheon tiers but unverified.
King of Liberty City wording: PS list 'Unlock all trophies.'; gta.wiki Social Club wording 'Unlock all achievements.'

Description wording: gta.wiki gives quoted text (used above); gtabase fetch returned paraphrases. Where punctuation differs (e.g. 'Fire Truck' vs 'Firefighter side mission'), gta.wiki wording was used.
Neither source was cross-checked against socialclub.rockstargames.com itself (not fetched); Social Club tier/points do not exist for the 15 SC-only entries.

Switch: no source confirms the Switch version reports Social Club accomplishments; scout_c notes one article frames them as PC-related. The user states their account tracks them, so treat as user-confirmed. No entry references PC-only features (all are gameplay/stat conditions).
